scope: Isolated Linux CPU engine evaluation, not packaged Papercut smoke or physical mobile acceptance.

method.coldDefinition: Fresh engine/model to first translated case; excludes interpreter process launch and imports, not an OS page-cache cold measurement.
method.memoryDefinition: Whole isolated process ru_maxrss in KiB; Node includes worker, Python includes its runtime. Not model bytes, incremental app memory or physical phone RAM.
method.timingDefinition: Sequential plain-text requests, no phrase probes or Papercut job/storage/render overhead in timed region. Bergamot cache disabled. One WASM worker; OPUS intra/inter threads both one. Different beam sizes and CPU kernels are deliberate configurations, not an apples-to-apples engine contest.
method.qualityDefinition: Authored diagnostic references and agent inspection, not blinded human review, a representative book benchmark, or release acceptance.
method.runtimeCaveat: OPUS models match the branch pins, but the official CTranslate2 4.8.3 Python wheel has different kernels/runtime from the branch ct2rs 0.9.19 Ruy build.
